answer:
The main best practice is **REL09**, "How do you back up data?" under the Reliability pillar. It asks you to back up data, applications and configuration to meet your recovery time objective (RTO) and recovery point objective (RPO) [S1]. It has four sub-practices:

- **REL09-BP01:** Identify and back up all data that needs to be backed up, or reproduce the data from sources [S1].
- **REL09-BP02:** Secure and encrypt backups [S1].
- **REL09-BP03:** Perform data backup automatically [S1].
- **REL09-BP04:** Perform periodic recovery of the data to verify backup integrity and processes [S1].

A related Sustainability practice, **SUS04-BP08**, says to back up data only when it is difficult to recreate, so you avoid storing backups of data that has no business value [S2].

Note that the 2020 edition of the framework has the same REL09 practices, but it is superseded by the 2024-11-06 edition, which I have used here [S4].
